title: Advanced Lettering, Balloon Styling & Story Text Editor
objective: Extend the basic SAA-09/10 text contract with speech/thought/shout/whisper and custom balloon styles, tail/border/fill controls, font fallback, kerning/spacing/alignment, batch story-dialogue editing, search/replace and speech-to-text authoring input while preserving text as editable semantic state.
acceptance: Lettering extends the sealed SAA-09/10 semantic text and anchoring contracts rather than replacing them with raster-only or presentation-only truth.
Speech, thought, shout, whisper and custom balloon styles remain explicit editable semantic/presentation state with stable text and target identities.
Tail, border and fill controls are explicit, reversible and scoped to governed balloon/text objects.
Font fallback, kerning, spacing and alignment preserve editable text semantics across supported projections.
Batch story/dialogue editing and search/replace operate only on authorized text targets and preserve source/provenance relationships.
Speech-to-text is an authoring-input path rather than automatic canonical dialogue or narrative truth, and provider-off authoring remains usable.
SAA-21 collaboration metadata and SAA-01..20 predecessor contracts remain sealed and are consumed without duplicate authority.
SAA-23 and later drawing/finishing/3D/scroll/print/multimedia/interchange/publication behavior remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-22 owns advanced lettering/text-editor behavior only and cannot create duplicate Dialogue, Character, Scene, ARI, AAI or narrative ledgers.
Editable semantic text remains authoritative; style/render projections cannot silently replace text identity or provenance.
Speech-to-text input may populate editable authoring text only within explicit permissions; it cannot silently commit owner truth.
No proprietary vendor code, private formats, assets, protected expression or undocumented protocols may be copied.
Provider-off/local operation remains valid for core lettering and text editing.
SAA-23 remains blocked until verified SAA-22 closeout.
next_action: Establish causal RED for advanced lettering, balloon styling, editable semantic story text, authorized batch editing/search-replace, deterministic font/layout controls, and speech-to-text authoring input; then implement only SAA-22.

last_material_progress.evidence: Owner Continue governed-started SAA-22 after verified SAA-21 closeout.
